findings.summary: IC power pin U201.7 (BOOT) has no DC path to a power rail (net '__unnamed_41')
findings.description: Pin U201.7 (BOOT) is type=power_in on net '__unnamed_41'. Graph walk (≤2 hops, rejecting capacitor edges, accepting resistors≤1Ω, inductors, ferrite beads, bridged solder jumpers) did not reach a named power rail. The pin is likely AC-coupled to ground only — the IC will not power up reliably.
findings.recommendation: Verify the schematic for this pin: the DC route must go through a conducting element (direct wire, 0Ω resistor, inductor, ferrite bead, or bridged solder jumper) — not a capacitor. If the intent was to tie VCC through an LC filter, add the missing inductor or 0Ω in series.

report_context.impact: IC supply floats DC; board will not run.

findings.summary: Crystal Y301: load capacitance marginal (8.0pF vs 7.0pF target)
findings.description: Crystal Y301 effective load capacitance is 8.0pF (+14.3% from 7.0pF target from value string). Mismatched CL shifts oscillation frequency and may cause marginal startup.
findings.recommendation: Adjust load capacitors so CL_eff = (C1*C2)/(C1+C2) + C_stray ≈ 7.0pF. Typical C_stray is 3-5pF.

text_annotations.text:
Open any sheet box to inspect its circuit.
Arrows show system relationships.
Shared power rails feed the interface sheets.

Review each page before PCB update. Downloads/checklist: downloads/FOOTPRINT_CAD_CHECKLIST.md
H1-H4: M3 clearance holes. Existing manual PCB has not been synchronized with this schematic.
P1 functional sheets copied | Your manual MOSFET bridge retained | CAD replacement and component review pending

SPI3 / I2C2 / FDCAN / UART
External timer feedback and ADC
Gate and brake control

Shield capacitor C207 is DNP.
Place USBLC6 at the connector.
USB service: connector, protection and bridge in one circuit

VBUS to control-power mux
USB-only source must allow >=500 mA.

LAYOUT: route the USB pair continuously from J201 through U202 to U901; avoid stubs.
C901/C902 belong at VREGIN; C903/C904 belong at VDD. Both pin groups use the same 3V3 rail.

UART labels are named from the MCU point of view.
TXD from U901 drives MCU RX. RTS/CTS are unused.
BOOT0 and reset remain manual controls on the MCU sheet.
VREGIN and VDD: both powered from 3V3
18-42 V operating bus • keyed XT60 • external fuse / precharge required
DNP: choose clamp and damping only after cable / hot-plug tests.
3 × 680 µF / 63 V bulk + local high-frequency bypass
2.00 V at 42 V; filter is AFTER isolation.
BRAKE CHOPPER - TWO COMMAND SOURCES, ONE GATE DRIVE
Internal 1.242 V reference returns directly to IN−.
Q501: D = pads 5-8; S = pads 1-3; G = pad 4.
U502: nominal ON 45.9 V / OFF 44.2 V. Board-bus backup only; thresholds have tolerance and dynamic overshoot.
The positive-feedback resistor is wired back to IN+.

top_issues.summary: IC power pin U201.7 (BOOT) has no DC path to a power rail (net '__unnamed_41')
top_issues.description: Pin U201.7 (BOOT) is type=power_in on net '__unnamed_41'. Graph walk (≤2 hops, rejecting capacitor edges, accepting resistors≤1Ω, inductors, ferrite beads, bridged solder jumpers) did not reach a named power rail. The pin is likely AC-coupled to ground only — the IC will not power up reliably.
top_issues.recommendation: Verify the schematic for this pin: the DC route must go through a conducting element (direct wire, 0Ω resistor, inductor, ferrite bead, or bridged solder jumper) — not a capacitor. If the intent was to tie VCC through an LC filter, add the missing inductor or 0Ω in series.

report_context.impact: IC supply floats DC; board will not run.
